pages.text: An Assimilation needs no Mutagen and no Matrix. The Maw absorbs it the moment its hunter completes a certain deed, whatever the Maw's Stage at that time. Five exist, spread across the Stages. The Maw's tooltip shows how many you have earned.

pages.title: Latent
pages.text: $(l)Gilded Pheromones$(): earned by entering the Nether. Hoglins and piglins no longer attack you unprovoked, as if you wore gold. Bartering with piglins sometimes pays double and can yield a wither skeleton skull. You must stay in the Nether for a few seconds, and carry a Maw for the effect to work.

pages.title: Advanced
pages.text: $(l)Nictitating Membrane$(): earned by staying a few seconds in the End. Endermen no longer take offence when you look them in the eye, but one you strike still answers.$(br2)$(l)Aquanaut Coalescence$(): earned by slaying an Elder Guardian. While in water with a Maw carried, you breathe freely and swim faster.

pages.title: Noble
pages.text: $(l)Oxytocinergic Esca$(): earned by winning a raid under the strongest Bad Omen. Every raid won afterwards adds stacks equal to its Bad Omen level, up to ten. While you carry a Maw, each stack lowers the price of every villager trade.

pages.title: Excelsior
pages.text: $(l)Eldritch Antenna$(): earned by holding all fourteen Mutations and the four other Assimilations. No creature will start a fight with you, but those you strike will answer. Bosses, Elder Guardians and raiders are beyond its reach.
